title: DEMETHYL-03 second terminal-methyl deletion series
scientific_question: What chemistry status, immutable AqSolDB structural coverage and frozen ESOL applicability-domain profile is observed for the complete unique neighborhood obtained by deleting exactly one more terminal methyl from the MOLDISC-009-selected DEMETHYL-03 structure?

generation.rule: parse the frozen DEMETHYL-03 SMILES; enumerate every carbon with atomic number 6, degree 1 and exactly three hydrogens; delete exactly one per raw product; sanitize; canonicalize to isomeric SMILES; deduplicate by canonical SMILES; sort canonical isomeric SMILES; assign variant IDs in that order

evidence.selection_rule: eligible iff chemistry_status == PASS and AqSolDB nearest Tanimoto >= 0.4; rank eligible products by higher nearest similarity and break exact ties by variant_id ascending

interpretation_boundaries: The MOLDISC-010 docking result is preserved as parent technical evidence only and does not drive generation, filtering, ranking or selection.
Generated products are E0_HEURISTIC structures and are not experimental observations.
AqSolDB nearest-neighbor measurements are measured-source structural context and are not transferred to candidates unless an exact canonical structure match exists.
Frozen ESOL values are E1_ML outputs; OUT_OF_DOMAIN values are unsupported extrapolative model outputs, not reliable solubility estimates.
MOLDISC-011 performs no docking and makes no affinity, potency, efficacy, safety, ADMET or biological claim.
